title: Career Roadmap: Analytics Engineer
summary: An Analytics Engineer transforms raw data into clean, reliable, well-structured datasets that business analysts, data scientists and decision-makers can use confidently. The role bridges data engineering and data analytics, with a strong focus on SQL, data modelling, transformation pipelines, testing and documentation.

facts.Current degree: BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis

blocks.text: An Analytics Engineer transforms raw data into clean, reliable, well-structured datasets that business analysts, data scientists and decision-makers can use confidently. The role bridges data engineering and data analytics, with a strong focus on SQL, data modelling, transformation pipelines, testing and documentation.
A BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis can provide a relevant foundation for this career when combined with practical experience in databases, data transformation and modern analytics tools.
Core responsibility
Transform raw data into trustworthy datasets, create reusable data models, automate quality checks and make data easier to use across an organization.
Work environments
Technology companies, fintech, e-commerce, consulting, SaaS businesses, analytics teams and organizations operating cloud data platforms.

rows.text: BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis
Follow the institution's official programme structure
Programming, databases, algorithms, statistics and data analysis
Advanced SQL, data modelling, transformation pipelines and analytics engineering tools
Data transformation projects, warehouse modelling and analytics internships
Optional specialization in data engineering, computer science, analytics or cloud data platforms

blocks.text: A relevant degree is a foundation rather than a guarantee of employment. Analytics engineering is highly practical, so a portfolio demonstrating clean, tested and documented data models is particularly valuable.
Year 1
Build programming and database foundations

items.text: Learn Python fundamentals, data structures and basic algorithms.
Study SQL, relational databases and database normalization.
Develop skills in statistics, spreadsheets and data interpretation.
Practise Git, GitHub and command-line basics.

blocks.text: Year 2
Learn data transformation and modelling

items.text: Master SQL joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimization.
Learn dimensional modelling, fact tables and dimension tables.
Practise cleaning, transforming and validating datasets.
Explore data warehouses and transformation frameworks such as dbt.

blocks.text: Year 3
Build production-style analytics systems

items.text: Create reusable transformation models with automated tests.
Learn data lineage, documentation and version control workflows.
Explore cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Amazon Redshift.
Complete internships and end-to-end analytics engineering projects.

blocks.text: Final stage
Prepare for employment

items.text: Build two or three complete analytics engineering projects.
Practise SQL interviews, data modelling and debugging.
Learn basic orchestration and deployment workflows.
Apply for Analytics Engineer, Junior Analytics Engineer and Data Transformation Developer roles.

blocks.text: Adapt the plan to the actual duration and curriculum of the BS programme.

rows.text: Joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation and optimization
Star schemas, fact tables, dimensions and reusable models
dbt or equivalent SQL-based transformation frameworks
BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or similar platforms
Assertions, schema validation, freshness checks and testing
Git, GitHub, branching and code reviews
Data dictionaries, lineage and model descriptions
Power BI, Tableau or equivalent tools for understanding downstream use

blocks.text: Data Modelling and Transformation
Develop reliable, reusable datasets from raw operational data using SQL transformations and well-designed warehouse schemas.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Junior Analytics Engineer, SQL Developer, Data Transformation Developer.
Business Intelligence Engineering
Prepare consistent analytical datasets and metrics that power dashboards, business reports and management decisions.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: BI Developer, Analytics Engineer, BI Data Modeler.
Cloud Analytics Engineering
Build transformation models and reliable analytical datasets on cloud data platforms, with attention to performance and cost.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Cloud Analytics Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer.
Data Quality and Governance
Improve the reliability, consistency, documentation and traceability of data used throughout an organization.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Data Quality Analyst, Data Governance Analyst, Data Reliability Specialist.
Look for internships with data teams, analytics consultancies, SaaS companies, fintech businesses, e-commerce platforms and business intelligence departments.
Recommended portfolio projects

blocks.label: Retail analytics warehouse
blocks.text: Transform raw sales data into fact and dimension tables and create consistent business metrics.

blocks.label: End-to-end dbt project
blocks.text: Build SQL transformation models with tests, documentation and dependency tracking.

blocks.label: Customer analytics model
blocks.text: Create reusable datasets for customer acquisition, retention and churn analysis.

blocks.label: Data quality framework
blocks.text: Implement checks for missing values, duplicates, invalid records and unexpected changes.

blocks.label: Cloud analytics pipeline
blocks.text: Load public data into a cloud warehouse, transform it and prepare reliable datasets for reporting.

For every project, document the source data, schema, transformation logic, tests, lineage, assumptions and limitations. Include a README and sample output so reviewers can understand how the project works.
Consider practical training in:

items.text: Advanced SQL and database design.
Analytics engineering with dbt.
Cloud data warehouses and platform fundamentals.
Dimensional modelling and data warehousing.
Python-based data processing.
Git, testing and collaborative software development.
BI tools and analytical metrics.

blocks.text: Certifications are optional for many entry-level roles. Prioritize demonstrable SQL ability, high-quality data models, testing practices and clear project documentation.
Data / Analytics Intern
Learn SQL, data preparation and reporting workflows
Junior Analytics Engineer
Build and test transformation models
Analytics Engineer / Senior Analytics Engineer
Own data models, metrics and data reliability
Lead Analytics Engineer / Analytics Architect
Guide data architecture, standards and engineering practices
Other pathways include data engineering, BI engineering, data architecture and analytics management. Progression depends on technical depth, platform experience, project ownership and leadership.

items.text: Automated data transformation and testing.
Modern cloud data warehouses and lakehouse platforms.
Data observability and lineage tracking.
Centralized business metrics and semantic layers.
AI-assisted SQL development and documentation.
Privacy-aware data access and governance.
Reliable data products for AI and machine-learning systems.

blocks.text: AI tools can accelerate SQL development, but analytics engineers must validate transformations, prevent metric inconsistencies and ensure data remains reliable and secure.
Preparation progress
Master SQL, including joins and window functions
Learn dimensional data modelling
Build transformation models using dbt or an equivalent tool
Implement automated data quality tests
Create a documented warehouse project
Gain practical experience through an internship or real-world project
Practise SQL, data modelling and debugging interviews

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: Students pursuing a BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis should focus on advanced SQL, data modelling, transformation frameworks and automated data quality. Build portfolio projects that turn raw data into well-tested, documented and reusable datasets. These practical skills are central to becoming an effective Analytics Engineer.
